$comment: Declarative DNS for WenMeet. Apply with `npm run infra:dns:plan` (dry run)
This file covers records the application depends on and that would
otherwise only exist as undocumented dashboard clicks. Records created
automatically by Netlify when a domain is attached to a site (type
NETLIFY, e.g. wenmeet.conscience.fund) are deliberately NOT listed:
they are owned by the platform, and managing them here would fight it.
The tool never deletes records it does not declare. Anything else in the
zone is reported as unmanaged and left alone.

records.why: Clerk production Frontend API. Sign-in breaks entirely without it, because the publishable key resolves auth against this host.
Return path for Clerk transactional mail (verification, magic links).
DKIM key 1 — without it Clerk mail is likely to be spam-filtered.
DKIM key 2 — Clerk rotates between the two.
